english.title: Driver of goods vehicle fail to give name /address / produce insurance / test certificate after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a goods vehicle test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle and any trailer drawn by it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) For failure merely to give name and address only see charge headings H39, H49 and H881.
(ii) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date see H326.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give **(..SPECIFY HIS/HER..) name and address to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant certificate of insurance and goods vehicle test certificate in respect of **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE/A TRAILER/THE VEHICLE AND A TRAILER DRAWN BY IT..) when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd nwyddau yn methu rhoi enw/cyfeiriad/cyflwyno tystysgrif yswiriant/prawf ar ôl trosedd/damwain ar y ffordd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd yn gyrru cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan ofynnodd gwnstabl i chi wneud hynny, bu i chi fethu rhoi eich enw a'ch cyfeiriad a chyflwyno'r dystysgrif yswiriant neu sicrwydd berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio dan Ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 a thystysgrif prawf cerbyd nwyddau a roddwyd yng nghyswllt y cerbyd neu unrhyw drelar a oedd yn cael ei dynnu ganddo
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd i roi ei enw a'i gyfeiriad i gwnstabl yr heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, a methodd gyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol a thystysgrif prawf cerbyd nwyddau yng nghyswllt **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE/A TRAILER/THE VEHICLE AND A TRAILER DRAWN BY IT..), pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neud o fewn saith diwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Tramgwyddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
